validation_log.check: User-requested Milestone 1.2 review: electrified-water personal-danger priority
validation_log.evidence: Reproduced with actual Flood simulation: player feet y=0.1, water y=0.5, electrify_at then tick(0.5); HP 100 -> 87.5, submerged time 0, personal status IN FLOODWATER and action KEEP YOUR HEAD ABOVE WATER. game/main.gd:650-668 considers only submersion for personal danger; game/flood.gd:255-256 applies 25 HP/s electricity at feet regardless of head height. Personal danger also suppresses Lightning's LEAVE THE RING AND WATER action. A global ELECTRIFIED WATER chip exists but does not correct the prioritized local instruction. Fix should prioritize leaving electrified water and account for simultaneous electric/drowning damage. Existing suites still pass: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=95, PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=50, DISASTER_COMBINATIONS_OK checks=20, PHASE7_POLISH_OK checks=34; none joins electrification damage with local danger copy. Display-backed HUD at 1280x720 with Dummy audio passed checks=177 and inspected motion-overlap remained readable/unobstructed. Intermittent successful-exit resource diagnostics remain. Reopened Task 1.2.3 and the priority gate; no gameplay code was changed during review. Temporary reproduction script removed after execution.

validation_log.check: User-reported inactive ENet authority errors: client lifecycle recovery
validation_log.evidence: Added tests/test_session_lifecycle.gd. Before the fix it reproduced The multiplayer instance isn't currently active through Player, disaster _can_mutate, GrabManager and main after real localhost server shutdown/failed retry, plus duplicate server_disconnected connections. Cause: closed ENet peer remained installed while flags reset; connection_failed had no handler. First clearing to null exposed camera unique-ID access without a peer; corrected recovery to install OfflineMultiplayerPeer before all cleanup. Final godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/test_session_lifecycle.gd: SESSION_LIFECYCLE_OK checks=46, with an explicit log scan finding no ERROR/SCRIPT ERROR. Covers real ENet handshake, server shutdown, unavailable-port failure (test-only shortened timeout), successful reconnect, repeated disconnect, seven gameplay registries restored to local ID 1, stale Flood cleanup, accessible error/lobby, and connected-client versus offline authority. No per-disaster guard weakening or client-authoritative simulation added. Documented command in README. Temporary before/after logs removed after inspection.
